## Summary

Describe the proposed CLI behavior in one clear sentence.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Why are the current commands or report formats
insufficient?

## Proposed interface

Show example commands, options, output, or triage/report behavior where useful.

~~~bash
trident scan . --format json
~~~

## Compatibility and safety

Describe impacts on exit codes, JSON/SARIF/table contracts, scanner execution,
LLM data handling, model feeds, and supported platforms.

## Alternatives

What other approaches did you consider?

## Additional context

Link to relevant documentation or prior art. Do not include credentials,
proprietary source, customer findings, or private model context.
